title: OpenAI launches always-on Dots agents
summary: At DevDay, OpenAI introduced Dots: persistent Astra-powered agents with their own cloud computer and browser that pursue user goals in the background.

title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 released
summary: Sonnet 5.5 keeps $2/$10 pricing, runs over 30% faster, and scores 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, nearly matching Opus 5.5 on GDPval-AA.

title: Claude agents find a CRISPR-like enzyme system
summary: Roughly a thousand Claude agents searched DNA databases for 21 hours and flagged an uncharacterized CRISPR-like system; its function remains unknown and experts urge caution.

title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna halve prices
summary: OpenAI brought Astra-derived training to cheaper tiers: Sol at $2/$10 and Luna at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens, about half their GPT-5.6 predecessors.

title: Claude Opus 5.5 released
summary: Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 on most work at $4/$20 per million tokens, jumping from 52.3% to 66.4% on Terminal-Bench 4.0.

title: xAI ships Grok 4.7 for long coding tasks
summary: Grok 4.7 adds a larger base model and longer RL on multi-hour coding, reaching 71.0% on DeepSWE v1.1 at unchanged $2/$6 pricing.

title: GPT-6 Astra scores 97.6% on FrontierMath Tier 4
summary: Epoch AI's hardest research-math tier is now close to solved: GPT-6 Astra scored 97.6%, up from a 22% best a year earlier.

title: GPT-6 Astra launches
summary: OpenAI's most powerful model targets computer use, coding and cybersecurity, but drew criticism because its opaque recurrent reasoning makes chain-of-thought harder to monitor.

title: Astra scores 62.7% on ARC-AGI-3
summary: Six months after frontier models scored under 1%, GPT-6 Astra reached 62.7% on the interactive benchmark, using fewer actions than humans on most levels.

title: Gemini 3.8 Flash pushes cheap near-frontier AI
summary: Google's fourth Flash model in four months ties GPT-5.6 Sol on the Artificial Analysis index at an introductory $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens.

title: Qwen3.8 flagship released as open weights
summary: Alibaba published Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, a 2.4-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 95B active parameters, its largest open-weight model yet.

title: Astra delivers a batch of new math results
summary: OpenAI's then-unreleased Astra model produced ten mathematical advances, including solutions to three more open Erdős problems.

title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole-body humanoid control
summary: DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2 for humanoid whole-body control and Gemini Robotics ER 2, an embodied-reasoning model available to developers via the Gemini API.

title: Kimi K3 becomes the largest open-weight model
summary: Moonshot released weights for its 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3, which Artificial Analysis rated alongside GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.

title: Claude Opus 5 released
summary: Opus 5 kept $5/$25 pricing while reporting 96% on SWE-bench Verified, 70.6% on OSWorld 2.0 and about 30% on ARC-AGI-3.

title: First officially graded perfect AI scores at the IMO
summary: Huawei's Celia and Xiaohongshu's dots-note-3.0 scored 42/42 under official IMO grading; other labs' perfect scores came from unofficial, AI-graded runs.

title: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna go public
summary: OpenAI's three-tier GPT-5.6 family reached general availability with a roughly 1M-token context window, led by Sol for agentic coding and science.

title: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 launch
summary: Anthropic's first public Mythos-class model debuted at $10/$50 with 1M context, but a US export directive forced it offline three days later.

title: AI disproves an 80-year-old Erdős conjecture
summary: An OpenAI general reasoning model found a new construction refuting Erdős's 1946 unit-distance conjecture, with supporting remarks from leading mathematicians.

title: Google I/O: Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Omni
summary: Google launched Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Omni, a model that turns text, image, audio or video input into editable video.

title: METR: Mythos can handle 16-hour tasks
summary: METR estimated an early Claude Mythos Preview has a 50% time horizon of at least 16 hours, the upper limit of what its tasks can measure.

title: DeepSeek V4 ships with 1M context, open weights
summary: DeepSeek released MIT-licensed V4-Pro (1.6T parameters) and V4-Flash with 1M-token context, pricing Pro output around a tenth of GPT-5.5's.

title: GPT-5.5 released
summary: GPT-5.5 posted 82.7% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and 58.6% on SWE-Bench Pro, but raised API prices to $5/$30 per million tokens.

title: Meta debuts Muse Spark
summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs' first model is a proprietary multimodal reasoner whose multi-agent Contemplating mode hits 58% on Humanity's Last Exam.

title: Claude Mythos Preview and Project Glasswing
summary: Anthropic withheld Mythos Preview from release after it found thousands of zero-days across major operating systems and browsers, sharing it with defenders instead.

title: ARC-AGI-3 launches; frontier AI scores under 1%
summary: The interactive ARC-AGI-3 benchmark debuted with humans solving every environment while the best frontier model, Gemini 3.1 Pro, managed 0.37%.

title: GPT-5.4 adds native computer use
summary: GPT-5.4 built computer use into the model and scored 75% on OSWorld-Verified, above the 72.4% human baseline.

title: Gemini 3.1 Pro hits 77.1% on ARC-AGI-2
summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro more than doubled its predecessor on ARC-AGI-2 and offered a 1M-token context window aimed at agent workloads.

title: Z.ai releases GLM-5
summary: GLM-5, a 744B MIT-licensed mixture-of-experts model reportedly trained on Huawei chips, became the top open-weight model on Artificial Analysis.

title: GPT-5.2 breaks 50% on ARC-AGI-2
summary: OpenAI's rushed GPT-5.2 reached 52.9% on ARC-AGI-2 and 70.9% on GDPval knowledge-work tasks.

title: Mistral 3 family goes open under Apache 2.0
summary: Mistral released Mistral Large 3, a 675B-parameter sparse MoE, plus three small Ministral 3 models, all multimodal and Apache 2.0.

title: DeepSeek V3.2-Speciale hits olympiad gold level
summary: DeepSeek released open-weight V3.2 and V3.2-Speciale, claiming gold-level results at IMO, IOI, CMO and the ICPC World Finals 2025.

title: Gemini 3 tops the leaderboards
summary: Gemini 3 Pro debuted at 1501 LMArena Elo and 37.5% on Humanity's Last Exam, with Deep Think reaching 45.1% on ARC-AGI-2.

title: Kimi K2 Thinking open-sourced
summary: Moonshot's 1T-parameter open reasoning model can chain 200–300 tool calls and scored about 43% on Humanity's Last Exam.

title: Claude Haiku 4.5 brings reasoning to the small tier
summary: Haiku 4.5 matched Sonnet 4-level coding at a third of the cost, $1/$5 per million tokens, and was the first Haiku with reasoning.
